card.name: Dosage-form word after a drug name
card.fires_on: The word right after a drug name or a repeated product name that names its form or route, such as tablets, capsules, extended, oral, or the in 'from the vial'. It is mostly seen in dosing and switching instructions.

modes.label: Form after drug name
modes.description: A dosage form or release type follows a drug name, often when comparing or switching products.
modes.example: When switching to a three times a day regimen of nicardipine<< capsules>>, administer the first dose 1 hour

modes.description: A route word or 'the' comes just before a noun for a vial or drug product.
